opening.argument: The speaker presents BitConnect lending as a way to double an investment in about 30 days, saying, “i double my investment right now,” and describing the possibility of turning $100 in BitConnect tokens into a million dollars. He then converts that claimed result into a recruitment appeal: viewers are told to “set up your own BitConnect account,” lend Bitcoin through BitConnect, and join his team, while he says everyone can make money and that he earns when they succeed. The displayed dashboard reinforces the solicitation, showing $280 in total and active investment and $101.67 earned, including lending profit and an affiliate bonus.
